Bunch of shady people. My partner came in to get her car fixed, took them 2 weeks to work on it, they ended up making it worse (they messed up the turbo while working on the belt), and when my partner asked for a refund, they were hesitant with her and were going back and forth with her.

And on another note, when my partner confronted them about the car still not functioning properly, they were condescending and acting like it was actually functioning. How can the driver of their own car say that something’s not working right and you dismiss them saying that it is?

Ended up wasting a thousand dollars for a worse car. If you had a great experience, lucky you. They decided to be decent people when you came around. We fortunately would not be seeing this place again.
